text: The clinic is clean, the prices are affordable, and the doctor gives excellent advice! 😍 …

I recently moved to this area, so I chose a clinic that was close and had good reviews. However, I was disappointed with several things. Let me break it down into points.

1. Parking is difficult, as it's located on Pattanakarn Road, which isn't very wide. I recommend a motorcycle, though you can find parking on the sidewalk.
2. The clinic is very narrow, and you can see the operating room behind the counter.
3. I'd like it to be renovated and better decorated to give it a fresher, cleaner look. This place is quite old, and it feels very unrelaxing (and scary, too).
4. The atmosphere in the dental office is very crowded and always chatting (I personally think they're family or long-time friends, as they talk about other things more than work). It makes me feel like an extra.
5. An experience I'll always remember. While I was waiting for my dentist, an old man came out of the dentist's office, having just had his teeth cleaned, and he groaned and complained, "It hurts so bad!" Then, after a while, he said, "Holy shit!" . When I went into the dental office, I had to get several x-rays before I could get through (I must have been a newbie). The atmosphere in the exam room was also very tense.  When I entered the dental room, the doctor or assistant asked the Burmese housekeeper to clean the blood from the seal (I'm pretty sure the blood from before was the man who complained about the pain).  When I actually got the dental treatment, it hurt like hell. Even just getting my tartar scraped hurt like this. There was a lot of blood, even though I have very little tartar, because I never break my dental floss.

Finally, I'd like to tell everyone, no matter what service you use, to read reviews carefully and check the reviewer's credibility.
